newsitem.title: USA: US Plains feedlot cattle priced at $65 - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains feedlot cattle priced at $65 - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlots priced cattle at $65.00 per cwt Thursday, after trading a large amount at $64.00 Wednesday, feedlot sources said.

Buyers raised bids late Wednesday to $64.00 and bought a large number of cattle in Texas and Kansas, cleaning up many showlists. In Kansas, some of the cattle were shipped to packing plants early Thursday, but Texas feedlot sources said it should be next week before the cattle are delivered.
"We have a new showlist today and are pricing them at $65.00," said a Texas feedlot source.
In Kansas, a few bids of $63.50 per cwt were passed early for cattle that were priced at $64.00. Other cattle at the same feedlot were priced at $65.00, one of managers said.
